meta.match_title: Pingu vs Chylith  [Pingu's match #1 of 10 pulled, most recent]
meta.result: PINGU WINS - "Chylith's life hit zero." Final life: Pingu (WINNER) 4, Chylith 0.
notes: UNLIKE Ze (whose account name "ze" shows in-game as "bel"), Pingu's account name and in-game/log display name are THE SAME — "Pingu" throughout, no alias. Worth noting as a contrast with the Ze batch, where the name substitution needed explicit tracking.

Pingu's deck HUD reads "BLUE/PURPLE DRAGON CONTROL" — a named archetype label, unlike Ze's generic "BLUE/PURPLE DECK" seen across all 10 of Ze's games. Not yet cross-referenced against a saved Pingu decklist (out of scope for this pass, same as Ze).

Both life totals are fully accounted for by named damage lines — Pingu drops 10->8->6->4 via three named Chillet hits (turns 1, 4, 17); Chylith drops 10->8->6->4->2->0 via five named hits (turns 3, 16, 19, 22 x2) — NO unexplained gap. A clean game to open the Pingu dataset.

4 bare-form interrupts (card name on its own line, no player/cost) preserved verbatim below for decklist cross-check: Turn 3:  Pyrin Noct interrupts Relaxaurus's attack Turn 7:  Cryolinx interrupts Elphidran's attack (1st of 2 occurrences) Turn 10: Cryolinx interrupts Elphidran's attack (2nd occurrence, same card/target type) Turn 19: Reindrix interrupts Chillet's attack 2 additional FULL-form interrupts occurred (Turn 5 "Pingu interrupted with Cryolinx, paid 1 Soul"; Turn 20 "Pingu interrupted with Pyrin Noct, paid 1 Soul") — not counted in the bare-form total, included in the verbatim body only.
